items.title: RSP joins local polls race as old parties move to guard their base
items.summary: The party has opened its Candidate Club for aspiring candidates, while the Congress, the UML and the Nepali Communist Party seek to retain and expand their local electoral base.

items.title: Two ex-ministers among ten arrested in Rs1.69 billion Malaysia fee racket
items.summary: Police say Nepali workers were charged an unauthorised 100-ringgit each, with 90 percent of the proceeds transferred to Malaysia through Nepal Rastra Bank.

items.title: Nepal's investment reforms yet to restore business confidence
items.summary: Business leaders say policy uncertainty, bureaucratic hurdles, local taxes and poor infrastructure continue to deter investment despite government pledges to improve the business climate.

items.title: India calls Shah’s visit ‘very important’, promises full state honours
items.summary: Kathmandu and New Delhi are still negotiating the key agenda items, possible deliverables and outcomes of the visit, as well as the contents of the joint communiqué and joint vision paper to be issued at its conclusion.

items.title: Nepali rock gets its moment on the world stage
items.summary: At 26, Bhojpur-born singer Pratik Himal Rai represented Nepal at Eurovision Song Contest Asia in Bangkok, and won over audiences even as he finished ninth.

items.title: Months after Bhotekoshi floods, families still await bodies and closure
items.summary: DNA matches alone cannot establish which missing family member the recovered remains belong to, and this has delayed identification and the return of bodies.

items.title: Shah and Lamichhane discuss the prime minister’s India visit
items.summary: Prime Minister Balendra Shah and RSP chair Rabi Lamichhane held a three-hour meeting on Friday to discuss Shah’s upcoming visit to India, his secretariat says.

items.title: The NPL has found its fans. Now it must go to them.
items.summary: If Nepal’s franchise cricket league wants to represent the whole country, it must stop playing every match in Kathmandu.

items.title: Businesses call for policy stability and effective implementation to boost investment
items.summary: Business leaders at a Kantipur Media Group forum in Biratnagar say policy uncertainty, bureaucratic hurdles and inadequate infrastructure are undermining investors.

items.title: Lack of verified data delays scholarships for flood-hit students
items.summary: Nearly three months after the Bhotekoshi catastrophe, the government has approved scholarships for 27 students, but the number of other children who lost their parents or homes remains unknown.

items.title: Nepal’s conflict victims still await justice 20 years after peace deal
items.summary: The International Commission of Jurists says thousands of survivors and families remain without truth, accountability or reparations, urging the government to revive the stalled transitional justice process.

items.title: Myanmar calls ICJ ruling on genocide ‘unfair’
items.summary: Thousands of Rohingya refugees living in sprawling ​camps in Bangladesh celebrated ​the verdict, but it ⁠remained unclear when they would be able to return home.

items.title: Wagle vows to pursue economic reforms beyond annual budget
items.summary: The finance minister says the government is tackling structural weaknesses, improving the investment climate and reforming capital markets while preparing an interim economic package.

items.title: Sirohiya calls for investor-friendly climate to revive economic growth
items.summary: Kantipur Media Group chairman says policy uncertainty and bureaucratic hurdles are holding back businesses, urging faster industrialisation and better access to bank financing to create jobs.

items.title: Trump, Iran war and AI upheaval to shape global outlook in 2027
items.summary: The Economist’s annual forecast identifies 10 forces set to influence global politics, financial markets, technology and society in the coming year.

items.title: Nepal begin Rising Stars campaign against formidable India A
items.summary: Tilak Varma praises Nepal’s progress, but Sandeep Lamichhane’s side face a formidable Indian team packed with international and IPL experience

items.title: Shah’s India visit to focus on reviewing ties and expanding cooperation, foreign ministry says
items.summary: A 34-member official delegation will accompany the prime minister for high-level talks, project inaugurations and agreements across several sectors during the two-day visit.
